advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a test that injects a transient write-side stderr on EVERY commit attempt through _git_commit / _git_commit_paths and asserts the total git-commit attempt count is bounded at 3 (not 9).
evidence: Commit-msg claim: 'That also collapses the accidental nested 3x3 budget on the commit paths back to the intended bounded 3.'

Existing coverage only proves retry-then-success: tests/interfaces/store/test_event_append_transient_retry.py:210 `_fail_first_commit(monkeypatch, _TRANSIENT_COMMIT_STDERR)` fails only the first commit, so attempt count is never asserted

gitutil budget test (test_a_persistent_write_fault_fails_after_the_bounded_budget) asserts `calls[0] == gitutil._TRANSIENT_FAULT_ATTEMPTS` for run_git_write only, not for the event_append _git_commit/_git_commit_paths paths which formerly had a distinct nested budget
ABSENCE: search for `_with_transient_fault_retry` in tests returned no matches; no test exercises a persistent transient across the full event_append commit path to pin its total attempt count at 3
advisory.finding: No test asserts the bounded attempt count on event_append's commit composition sites (_git_commit, _git_commit_paths, and the two UU-recovery commits), which is the specific behavior this diff claims to fix ('collapses the accidental nested 3x3 budget on the commit paths back to the intended bounded 3'). Existing commit tests inject a transient only on the FIRST attempt and succeed on the second, so a regression re-introducing the nested budget (9 attempts) or unbounding the loop on these paths would not be caught.
scenarios: A future edit re-nests a retry wrapper around _git_commit, restoring the 9-attempt budget that this change removed
A persistent write-side fault on a commit path loops more than the intended 3 times, masking a genuinely persistent fault
advisory.suggested_fix: In test_event_append_transient_retry.py, add a test using a _fail_ALL_commits helper (return the transient stderr on every commit) driving stage_and_commit / batch_stage_and_commit, and assert state['commits'] == 3, proving the collapsed bound on the event_append composition sites.
